english.title: The Sisterhood of Elune
english.objective: Speak to Sister Aquinne in Darnassus.
english.detail:
Blessings to you, <Class>. The Sisterhood of Elune has stood as a pillar of kaldorei society for thousands of years.

Before the Great Sundering, before the War of the Ancients, through the Long Vigil, we have guided and healed our people through the darkness. Such is our charge, and such is the demand of the peerless Mother Moon.

We now require your aid in a matter of great importance. Sister Aquinne awaits your arrival in Darnassus.

english.title: The Sisterhood of Elune
english.objective: Speak to Sister Aquinne in Darnassus.
english.complete: I am glad you arrived so quickly. The Sisterhood requires your aid.

english.title: The Temple of the Moon
english.objective: Sister Aquinne wants you to speak with Priestess A'moora in the Temple of the Moon.
english.complete: So, Sister Aquinne sent you?
english.detail:
A once great creature of the forest is in need of help, <race>.

There is a difficult task that must be done.

Please seek out Priestess A'moora; she will explain things to you. Find her to the southeast of here, inside the Temple of the Moon.

english.title: Tears of the Moon
english.objective: Priestess A'moora in the Temple of the Moon at Darnassus wants you to bring her Lady Sathrah's Silvery Spinnerets.
english.detail:
Lady Sathrah was once beloved of Elune. Graceful and pure, the spider spun her silver threads through the moonlight, catching the evening mist. The silvery dew had strong healing powers and was kept here in the temple.

But of late, Sathrah has descended into madness. Her future generations are now threatened as well.

Find Lady Sathrah, <Name>, and end her suffering. She dwells along the northern borders of Teldrassil, near Wellspring Lake. Gather her silvery spinnerets and bring them back to me.
english.progress:
I regret the task that I have asked you to carry out; but Lady Sathrah is beyond hope.

It is our hope to offer the sacrifice of the spinnerets to Elune. With this sacrifice, Elune will bless Sathrah so that she might be reborn, and at peace.
english.complete:
The forest mourns for Lady Sathrah, but it was something that had to be done.

Thank you, <name>.

english.title: Sathrah's Sacrifice
english.objective: Priestess A'moora wants you to place Lady Sathrah's silvery spinnerets at the fountain inside the temple, and then return to her.
english.detail:
Now you must finish the task to which you have been appointed. Take the spinnerets and offer Lady Sathrah's sacrifice to Elune; lay the great spider to rest.

Inside this temple, find the central fountain. There is where you may leave the sacrifice.  The holy waters will purify and cleanse the corruption that drove Sathrah mad.

When you have completed this, return to me.
english.progress: Have you placed the sacrifice at the fountain, <name>?
english.complete:
The loss of Lady Sathrah is distressing, but in this way only may she be reborn with a renewed spirit.

May Elune willingly accept the sacrifice that you have offered her.

english.title: Trouble In Darkshore?
english.detail:
How nice it is to see a <Class> interested in the great archeological wonders of our world.

Oftentimes our work is dismissed as mere hobby by our friends in the Alliance. But what many fail to realize is that recent discoveries in Khaz Modan have proven that a great and powerful force threatens all of Azeroth, from Lordaeron to Kalimdor.

I am most worried about my crew that I sent to Darkshore. They haven't sent word in weeks.

Travel to Auberdine and look for a clue as to their whereabouts.
english.complete: I'm so glad Chief Archeologist Greywhisker sent for us....

english.title: Nessa Shadowsong
english.detail:
A friend of mine, Nessa Shadowsong, is a fishing merchant in Rut'theran Village.  She needs a parcel taken to Darkshore, and is looking for someone to help her.

If you're interested, then to reach Nessa you must take the portal in Darnassus to Rut'theran Village.  You will find the portal west of the Temple Gardens.
english.complete: Yes, I have need of a courier who will take a package to Darkshore. Will you help me?

english.title: Eyes of the Sentinels
english.objective: Place Sentinel Owls at the entrance to the Cenarion Hold depths, the Darnassus Bank, the Craftsman's Terrace Inn, and the City Gate for Sentinel Dalia Sunblade in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
english.detail:
General Feathermoon ensures all sentinels have time to pray to Elune. A proper huntress wields not blade alone, but gifts of the goddess to overcome our enemies.

You may help with my daily duties. Place sentinels around the city--start with the tunnels leading beneath Cenarion Hold to the north, the bank at the center of town, the inn in the Craftsman's Terrace to the northeast, and the city gates. The guards can assist you.

Something is amiss in Teldrassil--we must remain vigilant.

english.complete: I thank you for your aid. Though I find peace in the daily rituals, it is nice to have a moment to reflect instead.

english.title: Humble Beginnings
english.objective: Go to Baros Alexston's house in Westfall and search for his compass, then return it to him in Cathedral Square of Stormwind.
english.detail:
It seems an eternity since I was a boy working the farm in Westfall. They say you can never go back, and it's true. Doubly true in my case, my family's home has been burned down and taken over by thieves.

I have spoken with my father about the fate of some of my possessions, including my first compass. He was unable to save them. However, he also says that they should be hidden away on the farm.

You'll find the Alexston Farmstead west of Sentinel Hill. Perhaps you could go and retrieve it for me?
english.complete: Oh, thank you, <name>! It's of no practical use to me, but the sentimental value... Needless to say, thank you for bringing this to me... at some cost to your own well-being, not to mention the time it took to go all the way down to Westfall. You have my gratitude, and have this as a token of my thanks.

english.title: Philmor's Favor
english.objective: Bring the Gatehouse Shipment to the stockroom entrance located in Trias' Cheese shop in the Trade District.
english.detail:
Every day this week we've been short dockhands.

Care to ease the stress on our cargo schedule?

Take this package to the stockroom entrance of the Gatehouse. You'll find it inside Trias' Cheese shop on the second floor. The mistress, Elaine, will be quite familiar with the deliveries. The Gatehouse often has shipments arriving with more discretion to allow for ceremonial surprises on behalf of the guard's officers.

english.title: Philmor's Favor
english.objective: Bring the Gatehouse Shipment to the stockroom entrance located in Trias' Cheese shop in the Trade District.
english.progress: You looking to fill a crate with our finest aged wheels?
english.complete: Oh, dear. You think we want to carry that up the stairs ourselves? Keeping the valuables intact is your responsibility up until the point you drop it off.

english.title: Gatehouse Goods
english.objective: Carry the Gatehouse Shipment up the stairs in Trias' shop and leave it outside the door.
english.detail:
Yes, it's only a flight of stairs, but if it's such a small ask, it should be no problem for you to finish the delivery yourself! 

Trias' Cheese isn't part of the Gatehouse or their stocking inventory, but our buildings share a floor.

Place the crate outside their stockroom door--the guard will send someone for a regular pickup. They will see the package arrival and carry it inside as they return to post.

english.title: Gatehouse Goods
english.objective: Carry the Gatehouse Shipment up the stairs in Trias' shop and leave it outside the door.
english.progress: You should at least try some of this aged cheddar. You can't stop eating it.
english.complete:
Yep. There's a reason that hinge opens inwards towards them, so they don't get the door blocked by people leaving stuff anywhere they please.

Consider us professionally acquainted, <class>. 

We respect your business, and expect you to respect ours.

english.title: Reading Room
english.objective: Bring the wrapped reading material to the Stormwind library.
english.complete:
Let's see here. Roy's Book Club, isn't it? I recognize this wrap technique. 

Well, if he says this is what people want to talk about, it's all fine by me. The material we receive back is always in as good of quality as we loaned it, so we know they're treating it with respect regardless of how provoking the words may be.
english.detail:
Are you here to discuss the deeper meanings of our storied legends? No?

Well, after you're done looking around, can you carry this to the library for me? We're exchanging some of our less popular bodies of work for some more modern writing. I have a list of tomes I'm quite sure the librarian will be able to procure for us within our existing arrangement.

Complimentary club refreshments on us, if you help us out.

english.title: Shelf Picked
english.objective: Find each of the reading materials located somewhere in the library and then return to Roy Lewells in Stormwind's Park.
english.progress: You forgot what you had to do the moment you stepped through the door, eh? Happens to everyone.
english.complete:
These are them! Some of them even smell exotic! Fantastic, I can't wait for us to have lively conversations about these writings.

Cellar after hours, of course.

Thanks for the quick errand run, <name>. As promised, it's on the house. We keep our word here.
english.detail:
I've checked our inventory and all of the selections Mr. Lewells has listed are currently available.

You will, however, need to procure them off the shelves yourself. Part of our librarian duty is vigilance, and for that, I will resume supervisory bookkeeping.

Returning with the material to Roy on his behalf will not mark yourself accountable for their return; as with his note you're serving as the book club's official courier. Their establishment shall carry that burden.

Good day, <name>.

english.title: ... and that note you found
english.objective: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.

<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."

english.title: Find Bingles
english.objective: Find Bingles Blastenheimer in Loch Modan.
english.detail:
We've lost contact with Bingles! He was sent on a reconnaissance mission over Gnomeregan and hasn't reported back in over a week. I just know he's gone and blown himself up.

He was last seen flying over the Loch. Perhaps you can investigate, <Name>.
english.complete:
So Gnoarn doesn't trust my reconnaissance abilities? I wonder why...

Nevermind that, I need your assistance! Nay! The movement needs your assistance!

english.title: Speak with Shoni
english.objective: Speak with Shoni the Shilent in Stormwind.
english.detail:
Perhaps... Perhaps you can help us in the battle for Gnomeregan.

In Stormwind you will find the commander of our underground assault crew, Shoni the Shilent. Shoni needs assistance with her gyrodrillmatic excavationators.

You will probably find her amongst the dwarves in Stormwind.

Good luck, <Name>.
english.complete: Do you bring word from central command?

english.title: Old Ironforge Incursion
english.objective: Enter the Hall of Thanes beneath Old Ironforge and claim the Head of Durgen Dirgehammer.
english.detail:
Gather some allies and head down into the caverns beneath Old Ironforge. Enter the Hall of Thanes there and push to the lower vaults. 

My Dark Iron is a bit rusty, but I can make out a name--one Durgen Dirgehammer. It's likely that he's the commander. Take his head and deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard. 

Oh, and when you do, tell him his old friend Farsen sends his regards!

english.title: Old Ironforge Incursion
english.objective: Enter the Hall of Thanes beneath Old Ironforge and claim the Head of Durgen Dirgehammer.
english.complete:
A Dark Iron incursion--right beneath our feet? Well, I'm relieved to hear that the Dark Iron commander has been dispatched.

The guards will head in and clean up the rest of the rabble. We'll see to it that the breaches are sealed and the lower levels reinforced to ensure that no further incursions are possible.

Thank ye for yer service to Ironforge, <class>. Take this as a small token of my gratitude. Oh, and if ye see that old Wildhammer rockhugger Farsen again, tell 'em to pay me a proper visit.

english.title: The Restless Dead
english.objective: Kill 15 Enraged Apparitions, 10 Tormented Souls and put the spirit of Anvilmar to rest.
english.detail:
Something has disturbed the tombs down in the Hall of Thanes, and strange noises have been heard coming from deep within the vaults. The spirits of the dead are light sleepers, and whatever is going on down there seems to have startled them.

Head down there and see what you can do about that for us. If any of the dead are awake--well, put them back down!

english.title: The Restless Dead
english.objective: Kill 15 Enraged Apparitions, 10 Tormented Souls and put the spirit of Anvilmar to rest.
english.progress: I don't have time for ghouls and ghosts. I have a job to do down here.
english.complete: Ah good, it's done then. I can't have the other keepers refusing to enter the hall to do their duties on account of "ghosts" and "angry dead", can I?

english.title: Important Heirlooms
english.objective: Collect 8 Dwarven Heirlooms from the Hall of Thanes.
english.detail:
You there, adventurer... I could really use your aid.

I was sneaking--uh... 'patrolling' in the vaults when a force of Dark Iron dwarves emerged from the depths in mole machines! I don't know what they are here for, but there is priceless loot--uh or, rather... I mean, 'important cultural heirlooms' down there! Please, recover any such relics you see and return them here.

I assure you that anything you recover will be catalogued and returned to its proper place of honor.

english.title: Important Heirlooms
english.objective: Collect 8 Dwarven Heirlooms from the Hall of Thanes.
english.progress: <Thom appears to absentmindedly rub his hands together as he looks at you.>
english.complete:
Look at you, as brave as you are enterprising! I'm a gnome of my word, and your reward is well earned! 

Now, let me take a look at the haul--uh, I mean... the recovered heirlooms. I need to get started appraising--excuse me, 'cataloging' them so that they can be put back in their proper places as quickly as possible.
